get_config: get the pretrain learner config for ImageNet using ResNet18 with SGD and cosine decay
get_test_config: get a lightweight test config with a linear model and one optimization step
build_pretrain_experiment: build a pretraining experiment on ImageNet with ResNet18 using the default config
review_get_config: review the get_config function to understand the ResNet18 pretraining setup and augmentation pipeline
refactor_get_test_config: refactor get_test_config to use a different lightweight model or batch size for faster tests
